name: io.github.oathline/oathline-guard
title: Oathline Guard
description: Wraps a stdio MCP server: reads pass, every other tool call waits for a person's coded yes.

packageArguments.name: --server
packageArguments.description: A short name for the guarded server; the approve window uses the same name

packageArguments.name: --reads
packageArguments.description: A JSON file listing the tools that pass without a yes; without it nothing passes

packageArguments.name: --human
packageArguments.description: The person whose typed code runs a held call
The real MCP server's command and its arguments
